releases.body:
Make the package loadable via the OpenCode `plugin` config field.

- `type: module` with `main`/`exports` pointing at the plugin so `import("opencode-omni-memory-plugin")` resolves the `OmniMemoryPlugin` hooks.
- CLI wrapper renamed to `bin/cli.cjs`.
- Declares the `@opencode-ai/plugin` peer dependency.

Published to npm via GitHub Actions trusted publishing (OIDC + provenance).
